title: Love this diner table for our 50s kitchen
text: Love this diner table for our 50s kitchen. We were looking for an authentic 50s diner table and this is perfect. It was easy to assemble and we purchased 4 red diner chairs to go with it.

product_metadata.title: BOWERY HILL 42" Round Vintage Retro Dining Table in White and Chrome
features: Retro chrome plated tables display iconic styling of mid-century diners
